name: space-octopus
description: Space Octopus Rev A motor controller — circular tscircuit project, copper draft and 3D review

scripts.build: tsx scripts/build.tsx && node scripts/create-mechanical-drawing.mjs && node scripts/create-review.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run export:3d && npm run check
scripts.check:source: node scripts/check-design.mjs && node scripts/check-rendered.mjs && node scripts/check-motor-interface.mjs && node scripts/check-mutations.mjs
scripts.route:native: tsx scripts/build.tsx --capture-only --json-only && timeout 190s node scripts/route-native-full.mjs && tsx scripts/save-routing.ts routing-work/native-full/traces.json tscircuit-native
scripts.route:finish: python scripts/finish-routing.py output/space-octopus.circuit.json && tsx scripts/save-routing.ts routing-work/grid/best.circuit.json local-grid-finishing
scripts.export:3d: node scripts/export-3d.mjs && node scripts/create-3d-viewer.mjs && node scripts/check-motor-mount.mjs && node scripts/create-mounting-drawing.mjs
scripts.export:jlc-quote: npm run export:review && python scripts/check-gerber-connectivity.py && python scripts/check-gerber-connectivity.py --edge-loss 0.025 --report output/gerber-etch-screen.json && python scripts/check-jlc-stencil.py && npm run simulate:bota && python scripts/export-jlc-quote.py
scripts.export:kicad:pdf: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/space-octopus-kicad/config XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/space-octopus-kicad/cache XDG_DATA_HOME=/tmp/space-octopus-kicad/data kicad-cli sch export pdf -o output/kicad/SpaceOctopus-schematics.pdf output/kicad/SpaceOctopus.kicad_sch
